'''''Tallaan Clippers''''' were a make of transport [[Starship/Legends|vessel]] with multiple decks used during the early days of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. One ''Tallaan Clipper'' in use in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]] was the ''[[Space Slug]]'' which the [[Kedorzhan]] [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Dewell Bronk]] and the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] booked passage on to escape [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] after the declaration of the [[New Order/Legends|New Order]], the former fleeing persecution for his involment in the [[Delegation of 2000]], and the later attempting to transport an infant [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] to [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].<ref name="Inc" />
